narrative.intro: Fisher Sand and Gravel received $13.4B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Fisher Sand and Gravel has 15 reported awards this fiscal year, with an average award size of $890M. Fisher Sand and Gravel saw obligations change up 1338.2% year over year. Fisher Sand and Gravel recorded prior-year obligations of $259M in FY23, $121M in FY24, and $928M in FY25, with zero recorded obligations in FY21 and FY22. The current-year total is partial and represents fiscal year to date activity, while the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables use total contract values rather than obligations. This snapshot highlights a rapid increase in federal spending with concentrated, large awards and a small count of transactions driving the total obligations. Fisher Sand and Gravel’s FY2026 to date performance will be relevant to prime contractors, subcontractors, and agency procurement teams tracking heavy-civil and materials suppliers with large, infrequent federal awards.

sections.body: Fisher Sand and Gravel’s obligations were up 1338.2% year over year. Fisher Sand and Gravel recorded $13.4B in FY26 to date after $928M in FY25 and $121M in FY24. Fisher Sand and Gravel had $259M in FY23 and $0 in FY22 and FY21, showing the FY26 total is a substantial step change.

sections.heading: How have Fisher Sand and Gravel’s obligations trended across recent fiscal years?
sections.body: Fisher Sand and Gravel posted $0 in FY21 and $0 in FY22, then $259M in FY23, $121M in FY24, and $928M in FY25. Fisher Sand and Gravel reached $13.4B in FY26 to date, reflecting a large increase concentrated in the current fiscal year. Fisher Sand and Gravel’s award count of 15 and average award size of $890M indicate few, high-value awards drove the FY26 total.
